sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Your labour and material cost pressures deserve recognition, though the weighted arithmetic does not explain the full increase. Thank you for setting out your cost drivers and for the price concessions you have made over our long relationship.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our offers allow room for recovery beyond current input inflation. We are flexible on payment terms; please choose the option that best supports your cash planning.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.90 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.97 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value your continued support and want our relationship to remain sustainable for your foundry.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the decrease in energy costs and have factored this verified reduction into our calculations.

As a family-owned foundry, our detailed cost structures are strictly confidential, but please be assured that our pricing reflects only the necessary adjustments to maintain the quality you expect. Building on your preferred 30-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of €135.50 per unit, effective 1 November 2026. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. For our planning, this offer stays valid for 30 days. Our current Angebot is a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering your offer after verifying the energy-cost reduction; we recognise that labour and material pressures remain. We respect the confidentiality of your costing and appreciate the support your family business has given us over the years.

We have made a modest price step and ask for a further concession in return for shorter payment terms: Option B retains the payment term you proposed at a lower price than the other options. We are flexible on payment timing; please choose the option that best supports your cash planning.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.60 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.07 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.40 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

We value our long relationship and want Brandlhuber to remain a healthy, dependable partner.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your recognition of the ongoing material and labour pressures we face. In response to your movement, we are prepared to make a further concession to help us reach an agreement. 

We propose a price of €134.50 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment terms that support our operations. For our complete Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your further concession; we recognise the material and labour pressures and your past support. The published German manufacturing labour cost index below is part of our evidence, not a measure of earlier underpricing.

The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We have made a modest step and seek a price concession in return for flexibility on timing: Option B gives you your requested effective date. We are flexible on the start date; which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 138.76 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 30 days net.
Option B: EUR 133.70 per unit, new price from 2026-11-01, payment 30 days net.
Option C: EUR 135.14 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 30 days net.

We appreciate your continued work toward a sustainable supply relationship.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We have already taken that index change data into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We appreciate your movement and, in the spirit of our long-standing partnership, are prepared to make a further concession. For our current Angebot, we propose a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

As an alternative at our standard terms, we propose a revised price of €134.10 per unit, maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date and 30-day payment terms, which represents a price of €134.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
